nodes.name: CeO2 QDs One-Pot Hydrothermal
nodes.procedure: CeO2 QDs with good crystallinity are synthesized via a one-pot hydrothermal method.
nodes.source_text: CeO2 QDs with good crystallinity are synthesized via a one-pot hydrothermal method.

nodes.name: Ir/CeO2 SANIs Low-Temp Reduction
nodes.procedure: Ir/CeO2 SANIs are prepared using a low-temperature in situ reduction approach. An aqueous solution containing CeO2 QDs and iridium chloride (IrCl3) is sealed in a flask, followed by the chemical reduction of Ir3+ using hydrazine hydrate as the reducing agent. The reaction proceeds at -20°C under an argon atmosphere for six h.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows Ir/CeO2 SANIs preserve CeO2 QDs morphology with diameter of ≈4-6 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The transmission electron microscopy (TEM) image in Figure 1b shows that Ir/CeO2 SANIs preserve the morphology of CeO2 QDs with a diameter of ≈4-6 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: HR-TEM shows lattice fringes corresponding to (111) and (220) planes of CeO2 QDs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution TEM (HR-TEM) image in Figure 1c clearly shows lattice fringes corresponding to the (111) and (220) planes of CeO2 QDs.

nodes.characterization_summary: AC HAADF-STEM reveals isolated Ir single-atoms embedded within CeO2 QDs lattice with average size of ≈1.7±0.2 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 1d, numerous isolated Ir single-atoms (highlighted by orange circles) are embedded within CeO2 QDs lattice, with an average size of ≈1.7±0.2 Å.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS shows uniform Ir distribution across CeO2 QDs with Ir loading of ≈1.1 wt%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Ir element is uniformly distributed across the entire area of CeO2 QDs (Figure 1e), with an Ir loading capacity of ≈1.1 wt.% (Figure S2, Supporting Information).

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD displays face-centered cubic CeO2 phase (PDF#34-0394) with no observable Ir phase; (111) and (220) peaks shift to low angles with lattice parameter expansion of ≈0.04 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of Ir/CeO2 SANIs in Figure 1f display a face-centered cubic structure of the CeO2 phase (PDF#34-0394), with no observable Ir phase... the (111) and (220) diffraction peaks of Ir/CeO2 SANIs exhibit a slight shift toward low angles, and the lattice parameter expands by ≈0.04 Å.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir 4f XPS shows single spin-orbit doublet at 60.8 eV (4f7/2) and 63.8 eV (4f5/2) indicating ≈81.5% zero-valent Ir atoms; higher Ce3+/Ce4+ ratio confirms enhanced electronic donation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the XPS spectrum of Ir/CeO2 SANIs in the Ir 4f region (Figure 1g) shows a single spin-orbit doublet with binding energies at 60.8 eV (4f7/2) and 63.8 eV (4f5/2), indicating that the majority of Ir single atoms are in the zero-valent state (≈81.5%).[18] As expected, the higher Ce3+/Ce4+ ratio in Ir/CeO2 SANIs (Figure 1g) compared to CeO2 QDs

nodes.characterization_summary: Normalized Ir L3-edge XANES indicates valence state similar to Ir foil (Ir0) rather than IrO2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The normalized Ir L3 edge XANES of Ir/CeO2 SANIs (Figure 1h) also indicate a valence state similar to Ir foil (Ir0) rather than IrO2.

nodes.characterization_summary: EXAFS shows only Ir-O peak at ≈1.9 Å with no Ir-Ir bonds.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Compared to bulk IrO2 and Ir foil, the EXAFS data from the Ir/CeO2 SANIs show only one peak corresponding to Ir-O bonds at ≈1.9 Å, with no detectable Ir-Ir bonds (Figure 1i).

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM of Ir/CeO2@Lipo reveals uniform small unilamellar spherical structures with QDs inside.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM images (Figure 2b) reveal uniform morphology characterized by small unilamellar spherical structures and uniform distribution of QDs inside, confirming the successful encapsulation of Ir/CeO2 SANIs within the liposomes.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM and EDS mapping of Ir/CeO2@Lipo show uniform Ce and Ir dispersion; intensity profiles indicate Ir-Ir distances of 0.44 nm and 0.41 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HAADF STEM images and EDS mapping (Figure 2c) illustrate the elemental distributions within a single Ir/CeO2@Lipo nanosphere... The intensity profiles in Figure 2d,e indicate that the distances between individual Ir are 0.44 and 0.41 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-OES quantifies significantly higher Ce concentration in tumor tissues compared to major organs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The concentration of Ce in the tumor tissues, as quantified by inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometry (ICP-OES), is significantly higher compared to that in major organs (Figure S17, Supporting Information).
